message.content:
Below is a list of the **federal statutory holidays** that create long weekends in Canada for the year 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the day‑off is usually observed on the following Monday.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if applicable) | Long Weekend Period |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday, Jan 1 | Monday, Jan 2 | Dec 30 – Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Monday, Feb 20 | — | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday, Mar 31 | — | Mar 31 – Apr 1 |
| Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 | — | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day | Saturday, Jul 1 | Monday, Jul 3 | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Monday, Sep 4 | — | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday, Oct 9 | — | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday, Nov 11 | Monday, Nov 13 | Nov 11 – Nov 13 |
| Christmas Day | Monday, Dec 25 | — | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, Dec 26 | — | Dec 24 – Dec 26 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island).  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can tailor the list accordingly.
